recommendations.title: Dollar spot risk is elevated
recommendations.message: Modelled risk is 39% (threshold 20%). Inspect turf closely for early straw-coloured lesions and consider a preventative fungicide application.

recommendations.title: Microdochium patch risk is building
recommendations.message: Modelled risk is 2/4. Conditions are turning favourable for the disease — increase monitoring frequency, especially after the next rain.

recommendations.title: Moisture surplus — ground may be soft
recommendations.message: 7-day water balance is + 32.300000mm. Avoid heavy machinery and reduce traffic on saturated turf to prevent compaction and rutting.

recommendations.title: Topsoil is saturated
recommendations.message: Modelled topsoil moisture is 44%. Avoid mowing, rolling or heavy foot traffic until it drains, to prevent compaction and surface damage.

recommendations.title: Soil temperature suits seeding, but moisture doesn't
recommendations.message: Soil temperature is 16.8°C (good for germination) but topsoil moisture is currently saturated — irrigate or let it drain before seeding.

recommendations.title: Extended leaf wetness
recommendations.message: Modelled leaf wetness probability is 88%, which raises disease pressure. Avoid evening irrigation and improve airflow/mowing height where practical.

recommendations.title: Spray window is workable, but rain is forecast
recommendations.message: Wind is forecast at up to 15 km/h, within the typical safe spraying range, but rain is also forecast today — check the product's rainfast interval before applying.

recommendations.title: Growth potential is high today
recommendations.message: Today's growth potential is 82% of maximum. Temperature is close to optimal for growth — a good day for mowing, and nitrogen will be used efficiently if feeding is due.

recommendations.title: Active growth — mow more frequently
recommendations.message: Growing degree days are accumulating at 11.1/day over the last week. Expect to mow every 3-4 days to avoid removing more than a third of leaf blade in one cut.
